description: Adjusted fatal risk ratios of exceeding the limit, too fast for conditions, alcohol, motorcycle and large truck within single- and multi-vehicle crashes and within crash types, with design-based Wald tests of homogeneity and the pooled model-A RR
population: CRSS police-reported crashes 2016-2024 with known maximum severity
method: Model A (speeding replaced by speeding type for the speeding exposures) plus stratum main effect and exposure x stratum interaction; stratum RR = ratio of predictive margins over the crashes of the stratum (domain of the full design); linearised CIs (t, 42 df); strata need >= 20 fatal crashes in the exposed and reference cells; Wald F on the equality of the stratum log RRs (RR scale) and on the logit interaction terms
